# SO-101 Suite

> A free, open-source (AGPL-3.0-or-later), beginner-friendly software suite for the SO-101 robot arm. One command installs it and opens a web app that detects the hardware, walks a first-time builder through motor IDs, assembly, calibration (every joint reads 0 at the middle of its range) and cameras, and teaches what each part is. It has a documented HTTP API, drop-in modules and a demo mode with simulated hardware, so AI agents can work on it without a robot.

SO-101 Suite is an independent community project. It is not affiliated with Hugging Face (LeRobot), The Robot Studio (SO-ARM100) or Feetech. Python 3.10 to 3.13 (stdlib HTTP server, scservo_sdk, OpenCV, NumPy, pySerial), plus a plain HTML/CSS/ES-module web app with no build step. Windows is untested.

Start with AGENTS.md. Hard rules: never open a real serial port in tests (SO101_NO_REAL_PORTS=1, use demo mode); never start a server on port 8000 (use a free high port such as 8150 with --no-browser, and stop it); the arm moves only when the person asked; no browser pop-ups; every disabled button says why; zero is the middle of the calibrated range.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Wendor-ai/so101-suite/blob/main/AGENTS.md): commands, repo map, hard rules, how to extend, definition of done
- [README.md](https://github.com/Wendor-ai/so101-suite/blob/main/README.md): what it is, quickstart for macOS, Linux, Raspberry Pi and Windows
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Wendor-ai/so101-suite/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): how to contribute

## Commands

- `./setup.sh` (macOS, Linux, Raspberry Pi) or `.\setup.ps1` (Windows): install and start
- `uv run so101 demo --no-browser --port 8150`: the app with simulated arms and cameras
- `uv run so101 doctor [--json]`: the checklist (what is connected, what is left) as text or JSON
- `uv run so101 mcp [--url URL] [--allow-motion]`: MCP server for AI clients, talks to the running app
- `SO101_NO_REAL_PORTS=1 uv run pytest -q` and `node --test "tests/js/*.test.mjs"`: the tests

- [Defaults](https://github.com/Wendor-ai/so101-suite/blob/main/docs/DEFAULTS.md): every factory default and who reads it
- [Configuration](https://github.com/Wendor-ai/so101-suite/blob/main/docs/CONFIGURATION.md): the git-ignored .env file and every setting it can hold

## HTTP API at a glance

JSON over HTTP on the app's port (default 8000), no authentication, errors are `{"error": "<sentence>"}`. `GET /api/suite/checklist` (what is left), `GET /api/suite/snapshot/<i>.jpg` (a camera picture), `GET /api/suite/diagnostics` (text report), `POST /api/suite/motors` (scan, ping, wiggle, set_id), `GET /api/state` (live arms and calibration), `POST /api/calib/<armIndex>/<start|center|finish|cancel>`, `POST /api/pp/<teach|release|stop|...>`, `ANY /api/m/<id>/<path>` (modules). Full list in docs/API.md.
